name: wikidata-20260922-all.json.bz2
notes: md5 and sha1 are the published checksums. sha256 is null until the P3a slicer's pass over the file completes; it is then copied from input.sha256 in processed/p3a-slice-20260922/run.json, which also records whether the file matched the published size, md5 and sha1 (input.verified). Fetched with raw/fetch.sh, a resumable loop in which each curl run resumes from the current file size (-C -); curl's own --retry is not used, because a retry truncates the file back to where that curl run started. The download started on 2026-09-24 with a 1.2 MB/s cap and runs uncapped since 13:35 UTC the same day (owner's choice). The P3a slice lives in processed/p3a-slice-20260922/ (see projects/p3a-clean-nary-corpus/slice/README.md).
